summary: Static review of the three Task-11 test artifacts (AddTagDialog.spec.ts, AddCustomFieldDialog.spec.ts, e2e/subscribers.spec.ts + webhook-fixture.ts). All 11 component-spec TDD anchors are present and behavioral; assertions verify real validation/emit/error-rendering behavior, not mock wiring. The litmus test holds for every component test (deleting the zod regex, the type-dependent refine, or the emit would fail the corresponding test). The submit-error assertions are NOT false greens: errors.generic IS seeded (en.json:253 / uk.json), and useApiError falls through to it because Task 2 left errors.tags.create.* / errors.customFields.create.* unseeded, so a real non-empty string renders. The numeric-rejection false-green concern is dispelled: the model value 'abc' survives the STRING->NUMBER switch and the computed() schema re-runs the NUMBER refine against it; happy-dom DOM sanitization does not write back into the vee-validate model on mount. Dialog teleport handling (document.querySelector via $/maybe) is correct, and emitted-event assertions correctly use the component wrapper. Slug-regex coverage matches the AC exactly (accepts course_buyer/paid-2024/2024_vip, rejects Foo Bar/abc!/33-char) and the canonical ^[a-z0-9_-]{1,32}$ is the only regex in the diff (non-canonical guard returns nothing). The E2E spec self-skips (test.skip, not fail) on backend-down and missing-seed with clear console messages, keeps the webhook POST in a single helper, uses a bounded 30s export-poll with a clean throw, parses the CSV for BOM+Cyrillic, and all data-test selectors it drives resolve to real elements (status badge exposes data-status='unsubscribed', matching backend lowercasing). Spec ownership is respected: SendPersonalMessageDialog.spec.ts and SubscribersFilterBar.spec.ts exist only from Task 10 commits and are NOT in Task 11's working-tree diff; no i18n/locales edits in the diff. Main gap: RecentExportsDialog (built in this task, with a non-trivial download/refresh-URL/progress state machine and the 200/409/410/503 refresh matrix) has NO component test — its behavior is exercised only by the self-skipping E2E, so in a backend-less CI run it has zero automated coverage.

findings.finding: RecentExportsDialog is authored in this task and carries real logic — the row state machine (DONE+downloadUrl -> Download, DONE+null -> Refresh URL, PENDING/RUNNING -> progress, FAILED/PURGED -> dash), badgeVariant() mapping, and the refresh-URL success/error branch that flips downloadUrl/expiresAt on 200 and disables the row + toasts on 409/410/429/503. None of this has a Vitest component spec. The only coverage is e2e/subscribers.spec.ts, which test.skip()s whenever the backend is not on localhost:8080 — i.e. in normal `pnpm test` / backend-less CI the entire RecentExportsDialog behaves with zero automated assertions. Task AC line 103 ('refresh-URL response codes (200, 409, 410, 503) all mapped to user-visible toasts via useApiError') is therefore not protected by any runnable test in CI. The litmus test fails at the component level: deleting the refresh-URL success branch or breaking badgeVariant would not fail any executable test in a backend-less run.
findings.suggestion: Add frontend/tests/components/RecentExportsDialog.spec.ts following the ExportCsvDialog.spec.ts precedent (mockNuxtImport useApi, mock vue-sonner, settle()). Concrete tests: (1) GET returns mixed rows -> assert [data-test=recent-export-download-{id}] present for DONE+downloadUrl, [data-test=recent-export-refresh-{id}] for DONE+null downloadUrl, [data-test=recent-export-progress-{id}] for PENDING/RUNNING, dash for FAILED/PURGED. (2) Refresh-URL 200: apiMock resolves {downloadUrl,expiresAt} -> assert the row flips to a Download link with the new href (row.downloadUrl bound to [data-test=recent-export-download-{id}] href). (3) Refresh-URL error matrix: for each of 409 export_in_flight / 410 export_purged / 410 export_failed / 503 service_unavailable, apiMock rejects -> assert toast.error called and the refresh button becomes disabled (row.disabled). (4) empty list -> [data-test=recent-exports-empty] visible. This closes the only AC whose behavior is currently untested in CI.

findings.finding: AddTagDialog_canonicalRegex_acceptsHyphenAndDigitLeading reuses ONE mounted dialog across the loop (paid-2024, then 2024_vip) without unmounting between iterations, relying on the component's internal resetForm() after a successful submit to clear the slug field for the next iteration. AddCustomFieldDialog's equivalent test (lines 58-69) deliberately remounts per case for isolation. The single-mount approach couples the assertion to resetForm() side effects and leaves residual state (submitError, the previous slug value before reset) that could mask a regression where the second slug is silently rejected because the field was not actually cleared. Not a false green today (assertion checks apiMock called once per iteration after mockReset), but it is the weaker of the two isolation styles in the same task.
findings.suggestion: Mirror the AddCustomFieldDialog pattern: remount inside the loop (await mountOpen() per slug) with wrapper.unmount() + document.body.innerHTML='' + apiMock.mockReset() between iterations, OR assert the slug input value is empty before setting the next value. This makes each positive case independent and removes the implicit dependency on resetForm() ordering.

findings.finding: The export-poll loop opens the Recent-exports dialog, and on the not-yet-DONE path presses Escape and re-clicks [data-test=subscribers-recent-exports-trigger] to reopen. This assumes Escape reliably closes the reka-ui dialog AND the trigger reliably reopens within one 1500ms tick. If a transient render leaves the dialog already open when the trigger is clicked, the click could toggle it closed and the next downloadLink lookup runs against a closed dialog, costing one wasted iteration (tolerated by the 30s budget) but making the failure message ('never showed a Download link') misleading if the real cause is dialog-toggle flakiness rather than a stuck export.
findings.suggestion: Make the reopen idempotent: before re-clicking the trigger, assert the dialog is closed (e.g. await expect(page.locator('[role=dialog]')).toHaveCount(0)) or use page.locator('[data-test=subscribers-recent-exports-trigger]').click() guarded by a visibility check. Optionally add the elapsed time and last-seen statuses to the timeout throw so a real stuck-export is distinguishable from dialog-toggle flake.

findings.finding: AddCustomFieldDialog_typeSwitch_swapsDefaultValueInput verifies STRING->text, NUMBER->number, DATE->date but never asserts the BOOLEAN branch, which is the only one that renders a <select> (tri-state) instead of an <input> and whose data-test=custom-field-default-input is on a different element type. The component's BOOLEAN tri-state (unset/true/false, defaultValue=null valid) is an explicit Task-11 edge case (task lines 210-211) yet is unexercised by any test.
findings.suggestion: Extend the test: await setType('BOOLEAN') then assert the default-value control is a SELECT (e.g. expect($('[data-test=custom-field-default-input]').element.tagName).toBe('SELECT')) and that it offers the empty/true/false options. Optionally add a valid-submit-with-BOOLEAN-unset case asserting body.defaultValue === null to lock in the tri-state contract.

findings.finding: Step 6 fills and saves the per-subscriber custom-field value 'Київ' but does not assert the save succeeded (no wait for the PATCH response or for an updated/persisted indicator) before navigating away in Step 7. The only downstream proof that the value persisted is the CSV containing 'Київ' in Step 7, so a silent save failure would surface as a confusing CSV-parse assertion failure rather than at the point of the actual defect.
findings.suggestion: After clicking [data-test=subscriber-custom-field-city-save], await page.waitForResponse on the PATCH to .../custom-fields (or assert a visible saved state / re-read the input value) so a save regression fails at Step 6 with a clear locus instead of masquerading as a CSV-content failure in Step 7.
